summary: bioAffinity Technologies filed an 8-K announcing that President and CEO Maria Zannes will present a corporate update at the H.C. Wainwright 28th Annual Global Investment Conference from September 14-16, 2026. The filing includes a press release and states there were 600,736 shares outstanding with an aggregate market value of approximately $5.9 million as of September 2, 2026. No special-situation transaction (merger, tender, spin-off, etc.) is involved; it is a routine investor-relations announcement, classified as None.
